notes.title: Sorta Dev: How this game came to be!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=3F4czUCHZC4;full][/previewyoutube]

Where I, [i]LeatherIceCream[/i] (the director of this game, i suppose) tell [i]you[/i] what this game [b]isn't[/b] for like 5 minutes.

These sorta devs seem fairly successful. Definitely I should make a few more before release.
I mean it's not doing [i]huge[/i] numbers, it's not gonna be enough sales to fund our retirement any time soon, but y'know, maybe we'll reach our low goal for sales.

However, business and finance aside, I'm pretty happy with the feedback and attention this game is getting!
It has a small, passionate community, for a game I enjoy making, so I'm honestly just living the dream right now!

We are currently making Chapter 5! You'd think that's quick progress for a couple passionate indie game devs, but that 'End of 2025' release plan is a little shaky rn. We also don't know if we'll get overshadowed by some other big title at the end of the year, which upgrades this plan to shaky proper.
Also, it's the finals in schools lately, so development time is at a premium.

In uncertain times like this, it makes me glad this game has as many fans as it does. Thanks everyone for reading[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHk9rWffFUE]![/url]

notes.title: Customization, HUD and YOU!
notes.notes:
Why have this normal, meticulously designed Heads Up Display, like such:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087603/da1d884fbeaddaa3b72c369730d1507a79c447e2.png[/img]

When you can make your OWN brilliant HUD layout!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087603/47da668007639aab12147f81c12cc546a47116fb.png[/img]

Art Design and Visibility is for losers! What do [b]I[/b] know about designing HUD anyway! Have you [i]seen[/i] my last game on here? 

You see, I tried my best to make as put customization in this game as possible, because I can't do player skins. Hlev refuses to change his stupid attire because he is animated Frame by Frame. So unlike 3D games or 2D games with puppet animation, replacing sprites is not easy,

I mean, look at this sprite sheet for the animation of him falling on his ass at the start of level 1:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087603/4484e97769e60b785c2dae1c7ed0e81520cae1cb.png[/img]

I'm not drawing all that again just to make him purple.


So instead, we do stuff like the Billboard, the Emotes you get by holding 1,2 or 3, AND the Custom HUD!

[previewyoutube=YEzkeePq-hE;full][/previewyoutube]

Here's a video showcasing this in action, letting you customize individual HUD elements, including Moving, Resizing, Rotating, and even Squishing & Stretching.
Just go nuts, it's fine, man!
Visibility and Convenience is now in YOUR hands.


And hey, thanks for reading this far
just [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHk9rWffFUE]'[/url]cus of that, here's a teaser for a new level!
Tho this one is [b]HEAVY SPOILERS[/b]. If you like Fun and being surprised, [b]DO NOT WATCH IT![/b] (Especially not at 3AM, oh my goodness gracious, you'd have to be crazy)

[previewyoutube=WN6zzvyxtws;full][/previewyoutube]

If you don't mind then go ahead, it's all about the freedom in this steam blog post.


I'm sorry, I was talking over you this whole time, did you wanna say something....?
Oh... 'What does ANY of this have to do with the game being based on GTA Myth videos from 2008'?
.... idk, wasn't customization way better back then or something?

Well thanks for stopping by on your gaming journey to read about our game, development is going pretty smoothly so far. We're getting ready to make the third boss, actually, she's a doozy.

See you next time in 500 years.

notes.title: Progress Update! Ghosts in the Club!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello again hlevrybody, Chapter 2 is going swimmingly so far, so here's footage of its second level:[/h3]

[h2]Party - Case 2: Neon Slow Mo[/h2]

Here's a video of that:

[previewyoutube=VGtdXvrmkjk;full][/previewyoutube]

You got the brand new enemy; the [b]Ghost Guard[/b]. Named after a certain.... [i]something[/i]... from some.... other game.

They're ghosts that walk back and forth and throw EMP Dynamite packs at you.
Yeah I bet you're %$@*& in your boots right now from all the new material in the final game, huh.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087603/6f7f00ede9783dbc61377bf9387bfdb3bdb819cb.png[/img]

It also showcases another new enemy called the [b]Heavy Cane Killer[/b]. He's a slow version of the regular guys, but he's the first enemy to have $4 of HP, [i]AND[/i] he's got two canes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087603/7e49aa6323b2356b4b79edf231ced84e38102637.png[/img]

That's it for today's myth news, We've currently started on the Boss of Chapter 2, which will take longer to make than a normal level. So if we're lucky, we'll have Chapter 2 playable from start to finish by the end of this month.

Alright, thanks everybody who's been sharing this game around, and thanks for noticing this announcement in the first place, we'll see ya later.

notes.title: Demo Update 0.5.12
notes.notes:
That's right, hlevrybody, we're actually updating the demo again! We're in the middle of chapter 2 right now, but we're releasing an update for the demo anyway, you never know what we'll do next. In this new update we made fixed some visual things, fixed a couple crashes, and added a new mechanic called the twirl mechanic, where you can wall jump when dashing into a wall from a slope! Half Fun!

Changes:
- Foo Fighters will only attack if one of them sees the player or are inside of a wall now

New Features:
- Added twirl mechanic (jump off of a wall when you dash into it from a slope)
- milk

Bugfix:
- Fixed a crash involving an npc in level 3
- Fixed a crash when pressing buttons on logo start
- Added walls to spots where you can fall off the map
- Added shadows to bonus case 1
- Trash bag props are no longer the same sprite everytime (whoops)

Thank you for reading, and hey, thank you for not interrupting me while I was talking, very respectful!
Unlit next time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087603/0abcfc2267ffa92bcbec7cf1c89c0184c4d07eca.gif[/img]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.5.8
notes.notes:
Hello hlevrybody, in this new update we made some changes to the 4th floor, added a couple more accessibility things in controls and did a bugfixing. Here's a list of tasks I did:

Changes:
- Boss in level 4 has been slowed down slightly
- Trees in level 4s arena are now darker once in battle
- Broken camera pieces are layered behind the train now for more clarity
- Enemies will now fall at a max speed
- One room in level 3 has been changed to be less confusing

New Features:
- New popup when you come back to a previously played level (Extra Hud Tip)
- Added Extra Hud keybind to controller
- Unbound reset button on controller (You can change this in controller settings)

Bugfix:
- fixed a crash involving a bus
